scope: nine-pilot verification, RK4 comparison, reduced analytic case and band sensitivity

acceptance.contact_margin_rule: max(1 N, 10 times largest compared sampled minimum difference)

acceptance.basis: predeclared diagnostic choices; not certified bounds

solver.message: The solver successfully reached the end of the integration interval.

sources.adaptation: closed-form unforced damped oscillator; wheel clamp diagnostic

limitations: Deliberately constrained wheel: verifies the body equation and integration only.
Does not verify the full coupled quarter-car, road forcing or tyre equation.
Grid discrepancies are observed errors, not a continuous-time error bound.
Does not validate the model against a real vehicle or change the study model.

decision: Adopt RK45 rtol=1e-6, atol=[1e-9 m,1e-8 m/s,1e-9 m,1e-8 m/s], max_step=0.005 s, 1 ms observations and 5 s duration as the starting settings for later runs. All nine pilots agree with the tighter/longer reference within the declared limits. Every later setup must still pass contact and tail checks; unresolved runs must be investigated, not silently used as labels.
